title: Class-by-class portrait inspiration for D&D 5e
excerpt: A class-by-class round-up of what makes a D&D 5e portrait land. Painterly hooks for all twelve classes, anchored in silhouette and brushwork, not stat blocks.
seo_title: D&D Class Portrait Inspiration: 12-Class Painter's Guide
